title: VLSM Session Payload
description: Persisted shape of a saved VLSM planner session as accepted by POST /api/v1/sessions and returned by GET /api/v1/sessions/{id}. Currently IPv4 only; IPv6 VLSM sessions are not persisted in this version.

network.description: Parent IPv4 network address (with or without an attached prefix).

cidr.description: Parent prefix length as a bare number (no leading slash). Server-side handlers also accept this with a leading slash but it is normalised on save.

requirements.description: Subnet requirements, sorted largest-first by the allocator at calculation time. Order is preserved as provided.

hosts.description: Required number of usable host addresses.
